desc: Revoke an entity's access to an app that has its permission type set to named_entities

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs whose named_entities access will be revoked

access_denied.desc: This actor does not have access to the permissions on this resource.

named_entities_cannot_be_empty.desc: There must be at least one valid named entity

not_an_enterprise.desc: This feature is only available on Enterprise Grid plans.

invalid_permission_type.desc: This app requires permission_type to be set as named_entities before removing users.

too_many_named_entities.desc: Too many named entities passed into the app permissions setting.

app_acl_not_found.desc: This app does not have an ACL.

invalid_channel_restriction_mode.desc: Cannot remove channels when channel_restriction_mode is all_channels.

channel_not_found.desc: One or more channel IDs are not valid.

failed_to_update_channels.desc: An error occurred while updating the channel restriction list.
